verdict.rationale: Penpot explicitly markets itself as an 'Open-source alternative' to Figma (penpot-docs-16) and provides extensive self-hosting documentation (docker-compose, Helm charts, on-premise deployment) that only makes sense if the source is openly available (penpot-docs-7, penpot-docs-8, penpot-docs-28, penpot-docs-30). A runtime probe even confirms the official docker-compose stack actually boots a real self-hosted Penpot instance (penpot-probe-rt-1), corroborating that the shipped source can be run and inspected. However, the evidence pack never names the specific open-source license (e.g., MPL/AGPL) or links directly to a source-code repository. Missing for 10: explicit license name/citation, direct link to the public source repo.
